serviceTimeMs.how: mean = the Flask service (gunicorn)'s CPU per request at 1308 req/s net of idle: (43603 - 61 ms at rest) / 39241 requests = 1.1096 ms; shape (p95/median 1.0703/0.2882 ms) from the handler's own time

clientLinkLatencyMs.how: anchored: (measured median 1.294 ms - the model's median without it 1.987 ms at 1308 req/s) / 2, one way, at least 0

serviceTimeByLoad.how: the staircase's CPU per request net of idle (1.7285 ms at 50, 1.0033 ms at 751, 1.1079 ms at 1308 req/s), fitted never rising with rate and divided by the top rate's (1.1079 ms); flat outside the staircase

gcPauseMs.how: not modelled as a pause: each gunicorn worker collects on its own and stalls only its own request; the collections' CPU is in the CPU per request

dbLinkLatencyMs.how: each way: the round trip the service measured less PostgreSQL's time, in two legs that keep its mean and variance (median 0.1072, p95 1.4516 ms)
